records.name: DMLT Colleges (Various)
records.description: DMLT (Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology) programs are offered by government and private medical institutions across all states, providing trained laboratory technicians for clinical, pathological, and biochemical testing. These programs are approved by respective state medical faculties or boards and typically run for two years including a practical internship. DMLT professionals are essential to the functioning of hospitals, diagnostic centers, and public health laboratories across India.

records.name: IIT Bombay (ECE)
records.description: IIT Bombay's Department of Electrical Engineering (specializing in Electronics and Communication) offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs with research strengths in VLSI design, RF and microwave engineering, signal processing, and wireless communication systems. The department has produced numerous leading engineers at global semiconductor companies like Intel, Qualcomm, and MediaTek and is a key contributor to India's chip design ecosystem. It hosts industry-sponsored research centers in semiconductor design and communication technology.

records.name: IIT Madras (ECE)
records.description: IIT Madras's Department of Electrical Engineering (ECE track) is one of the strongest in India for electronics and communications, with research in photonics, power electronics, embedded systems, and next-generation wireless networks. The department is associated with prestigious research centers including the IITM Research Park, which hosts over 100 technology companies and startups. Its Ph.D. program attracts students from top institutions globally, and it is a key institution in India's emerging semiconductor and 5G technology ecosystem.

records.name: IIT Bombay (Mechanical)
records.description: IIT Bombay's Department of Mechanical Engineering is consistently ranked among the top mechanical engineering departments in India, with research areas spanning robotics, manufacturing, fluid mechanics, and thermal engineering. It offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs and is associated with the National Centre for Aerospace Innovation and Research (NCAIR). IIT Bombay Mechanical graduates are highly placed in automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, and consulting sectors.

records.name: IIT Madras (Mechanical)
records.description: IIT Madras's Department of Mechanical Engineering is widely regarded as India's leading mechanical engineering department, with internationally recognized research in tribology, machine design, computational fluid dynamics, and manufacturing technology. It offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs and has strong ties with automotive companies like TVS, Ashok Leyland, and Hyundai as well as global research institutions. The department houses several national facilities in precision manufacturing, energy systems, and ocean engineering.

records.name: IIT Bombay (Civil)
records.description: IIT Bombay's Department of Civil Engineering is one of India's top civil engineering departments, with research strengths in structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, transportation engineering, and water resources. It offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs and has strong collaborations with NHAI, RITES, and international infrastructure companies. The department is known for its work in earthquake engineering and sustainable infrastructure for Indian cities.

records.name: IIT Madras (Civil)
records.description: IIT Madras's Department of Civil Engineering is a top-ranked department known for research in structural health monitoring, coastal engineering, transportation, and environmental engineering. It offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs and is particularly well known for its ocean engineering and coastal infrastructure research programs. The department contributes significantly to India's infrastructure development through research, consulting, and policy inputs.

records.name: IIT Bombay (Chemical)
records.description: IIT Bombay's Department of Chemical Engineering is one of India's premier chemical engineering departments, with research in reaction engineering, polymer science, process systems engineering, and energy systems. It offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs and has strong linkages with India's chemical and petrochemical industry. The department is known for producing industry leaders who head R&D and operations at Reliance Industries, BASF, and multinational chemical companies.

records.name: IIT Madras (Aerospace)
records.description: IIT Madras's Department of Aerospace Engineering is one of India's finest, consistently ranked #1 in aerospace by NIRF, offering B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs in aerodynamics, propulsion, structures, and guidance and control. It houses the National Trisonic Aerodynamic Facility (NTAF) and works closely with ISRO, DRDO, and HAL on national aerospace programs. Many IIT Madras aerospace alumni have contributed to landmark Indian missions including the successful Chandrayaan and Mars Orbiter Mission.

records.name: IIT Bombay (Aerospace)
records.description: IIT Bombay's Department of Aerospace Engineering offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs with research strengths in flight mechanics, satellite structures, propulsion, and composite materials. The department has a wind tunnel facility and collaborates with ISRO, HAL, and DRDO on national aerospace programs. IIT Bombay aerospace graduates work at leading aerospace organizations and technology startups in India and internationally.
